arxiv-2007-09834.creator: Isa Inuwa-Dutse, Mark Liptrott, Ioannis Korkontzelos
arxiv-2007-09834.description: Abstract The migration rate and the level of resentments towards migrants are an important issue in modern civilisation. The infamous EU refugee crisis caught many countries unprepared, leading to sporadic and rudimentary containment measures that, in turn, led to significant public discourse.

arxiv-2404-19595.title: Perceptual Constancy Constrained Single Opinion Score Calibration for Image Quality Assessment
arxiv-2404-19595.creator: Lei Wang, Desen Yuan
arxiv-2404-19595.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Lei Wang, Desen Yuan. In this paper, we propose a highly efficient method to estimate an image’s mean opinion score (MOS) from a single opinion score (SOS). Assuming that each SOS is the observed sample of a normal distribution and the MOS is its unknown expectation, the MOS inference is formulated as a maximum likelihood estimation problem, where the perceptual correlation of pairwise images is considered in modeling the likelihood of SOS.

arxiv-2506-06912.title: Sleep Stage Classification using Multimodal Embedding Fusion from EOG and PSM
arxiv-2506-06912.creator: Olivier Papillon, Rafik Goubran, Life Fellow IEEE, James Green, Senior Member IEEE, Julien Larivière-Chartier, Caitlin Higginson, Frank Knoefel, MD, Rébecca Robillard
arxiv-2506-06912.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Olivier Papillon, Rafik Goubran, Life Fellow IEEE, James Green, Senior Member IEEE, Julien Larivière-Chartier, Caitlin Higginson, Frank Knoefel, MD, Rébecca Robillard. Accurate sleep stage classification is essential for diagnosing sleep disorders, particularly in aging populations. While traditional polysomnography (PSG) relies on electroencephalography (EEG) as the gold standard, its complexity and need for specialized equipment make home-based sleep monitoring challenging. To address this limitation, we investigate the use of electrooculography (EOG) and pressure-sensitive mats (PSM) as less obtrusive alternatives for five-stage sleep-wake classification.

pmc-11346555.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The factors affecting the antibody responses to the ZF2001 vaccine remain unknown. pmc-12663709.title: Total Hip Arthroplasty After Femoral Neck Fracture in an Ipsilateral High Transfemoral Amputee With Less Than 50% Femoral Length
pmc-12663709.creator: Tomasz Pobozy, Kacper Janowski, Klaudia Michalak, Natalia Rulewska, Filip Grabowski, Wojciech Konarski
pmc-12663709.description: Total hip arthroplasty (THA) in ipsilateral transfemoral amputees is rare and technically demanding; literature seldom quantifies stump length. We report a 69-year-old male with ipsilateral high transfemoral amputation (<50% femoral length) who sustained a displaced subcapital femoral neck fracture and underwent primary THA. The residual femoral stump measured approximately 215 mm (46.7% of contralateral femoral length) on preoperative CT-based templating.

pmc-13365617.title: Superior colliculus modulates the compulsion in a model of addiction with foot-shock
pmc-13365617.creator: Meng-Die Yang, Jian-Guo Chen, Fang Wang, Ning Wu, Jin Li, Li-Hong Long, Rui Song
pmc-13365617.description: Compulsive drug use despite negative consequences is a core addiction feature and key therapeutic target. Animal models utilize footshock to screen for mice exhibiting compulsive-like addiction traits. Following the administration of aversive stimuli, compulsive animals persist in drug-seeking, suggesting that addicted individuals may have impaired innate defensive responses, thereby exacerbating addictive behaviors.
